CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_DetalleEjecucion_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Ejecucion_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @DetalleEjecucionFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		DetalleEjecucion_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @DetalleEjecucionFilter (DetalleEjecucion_Id)
		SELECT 
			[DetalleEjecucion].Id
		FROM [dbo].[DetalleEjecucion]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[DetalleEjecucion].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @DetalleEjecucionFilter (DetalleEjecucion_Id)
		SELECT 
			[DetalleEjecucion].Id
		FROM [dbo].[DetalleEjecucion]
		WHERE
			 (([DetalleEjecucion].[Ejecucion_Id] = @Ejecucion_Id) OR (@Ejecucion_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[DetalleEjecucion].[Id],		
		[DetalleEjecucion].[DescripcionDocumento] AS [Descripcion],		
		[DetalleEjecucion].[FechaInicio],
		[DetalleEjecucion].[CompletadoEn],
		[DetalleEjecucion].[ProcesoCompletado]
	FROM @DetalleEjecucionFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[DetalleEjecucion] 
			ON [DetalleEjecucion].[Id] = filter.[DetalleEjecucion_Id] 			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Ejecucion]
		ON [dbo].[DetalleEjecucion].[Ejecucion_Id] = [dbo].[Ejecucion].[Id] 

END
